statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are clinically consistent with the patient's known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) was ordered
The study is to further evaluate the nature and frequency of suspected arrhythmic episodes
The diagnosis code I49.9 (paroxysmal arrhythmia) was submitted
The diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) was submitted
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
